hypotheses.nda-1: All Confidential Information shall be expressly identified by the Disclosing Party.
hypotheses.nda-10: Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that Agreement was agreed or negotiated.
hypotheses.nda-11: Receiving Party shall not reverse engineer any objects which embody Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.
hypotheses.nda-12: Receiving Party may independently develop information similar to Confidential Information.
hypotheses.nda-13: Receiving Party may acquire information similar to Confidential Information from a third party.
hypotheses.nda-15: Agreement shall not grant Receiving Party any right to Confidential Information.
hypotheses.nda-16: Receiving Party shall destroy or return some Confidential Information upon the termination of Agreement.
hypotheses.nda-17: Receiving Party may create a copy of some Confidential Information in some circumstances.
hypotheses.nda-18: Receiving Party shall not solicit some of Disclosing Party's representatives.
hypotheses.nda-19: Some obligations of Agreement may survive termination of Agreement.
hypotheses.nda-2: Confidential Information shall only include technical information.
hypotheses.nda-20: Receiving Party may retain some Confidential Information even after the return or destruction of Confidential Information.
hypotheses.nda-3: Confidential Information may include verbally conveyed information.
hypotheses.nda-4: Receiving Party shall not use any Confidential Information for any purpose other than the purposes stated in Agreement.
hypotheses.nda-5: Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some of Receiving Party's employees.
hypotheses.nda-7: Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some third-parties (including consultants, agents and professional advisors).
hypotheses.nda-8: Receiving Party shall notify Disclosing Party in case Receiving Party is required by law, regulation or judicial process to disclose any Confidential Information.
